key.name: keep-playing
key.summary: Keep playing when the window is closed
key.description: Closing the window hides it; the music and Spotify Connect carry on until Descant is quit from the main menu.

key.name: volume
key.description: Descant’s own volume, in percent, on top of the system volume.

key.name: equalizer
key.description: Whether the equalizer shapes what plays on this computer.

key.name: equalizer-gains
key.description: The gain of each of the ten bands (60 Hz to 16 kHz), in dB, from −12 to 12.

key.name: equalizer-preamp
key.description: A gain on everything, in dB.

key.name: resume
key.description: The context (empty for none), the track and the position in milliseconds, so the next start picks up there.
